t: am / is / are — «boʻlmoq» feʼli
d: Oʻzbekchada «Men talabaman» deymiz va «boʻlmoq» feʼli koʻrinmaydi. Inglizchada u albatta yoziladi: I bilan am, he/she/it bilan is, you/we/they bilan are.
f: I am · he / she / it is · you / we / they are
q: Savolda are gap boshiga chiqadi: Are you…?

t: a / an / the
d: Bitta, hali nomaʼlum narsa haqida gapirganda a qoʻyiladi, unli tovush oldidan esa an (an apple, an hour). Ikkalamizga maʼlum, aniq narsa oldidan the keladi. Oʻzbekchada bunday soʻz yoʻq, shuning uchun koʻpincha unutiladi.
f: a + undosh (a book) · an + unli (an egg) · the + aniq narsa
ex: She eats an apple every day.
U har kuni bitta olma yeydi.
q: umbrella unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an.
hour soʻzida h oʻqilmaydi, u unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an.

t: Koʻplik -s va this / these / that / those
d: Koʻplikda otga -s qoʻshiladi: book → books. Sondan keyin ham -s qoladi: two books. Ayrim soʻzlar boshqacha oʻzgaradi: man → men, child → children. Yaqindagi narsa: this (bitta), these (koʻp). Uzoqdagi narsa: that (bitta), those (koʻp).
f: this / that + bitta · these / those + koʻp
q: There are five ___ in the room.

t: Hozirgi oddiy zamon: odat va doimiy ishlar
d: Har kuni, doim, odatda boʻladigan ish uchun feʼlning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi: I work, we live. Gap tartibi: kim + feʼl + nima/qayerda. Feʼl egadan keyin darhol keladi, oʻzbekchadagidek gap oxirida emas.
f: I / you / we / they + feʼl (work, live, like)
ex: Men har kuni ertalab choy ichaman.
q: we bilan feʼlning oddiy shakli: live.

t: he / she / it + feʼl + s
d: Hozirgi oddiy zamonda he, she, it (yoki bitta odam, bitta narsa) bilan feʼlga -s qoʻshiladi: she works. -sh, -ch, -o, -x bilan tugasa -es: he watches, she goes. Undosh + y boʻlsa -ies: study → studies. have esa has boʻladi.
f: he / she / it + feʼl + s (works, goes, has)
ex: My brother watches TV every evening.
Akam har kuni kechqurun televizor koʻradi.

t: Inkor va savol: don’t / doesn’t, Do / Does
d: Inkor gapda feʼldan oldin don’t, he/she/it bilan doesn’t qoʻyiladi va feʼlga -s qoʻshilmaydi: She doesn’t work. Savolda Do yoki Does gap boshiga chiqadi: Do you like tea? Does he speak English?
f: I don’t + feʼl · he doesn’t + feʼl · Do you…? · Does she…?

t: Egalik: my, your, his, her … va ʼs
d: Oʻzbekchadagi -im, -ing, -i qoʻshimchalari oʻrniga otdan oldin alohida soʻz qoʻyiladi: my book — kitobim. Odamga tegishli narsa uchun ʼs ishlatiladi: Ali’s phone — Alining telefoni.
f: my · your · his · her · its · our · their · Ali’s + ot
ex: Our flat is on the fifth floor.

t: There is / There are — «… bor»
d: Biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun There is (bitta) va There are (koʻp) ishlatiladi. Oʻzbekchadagi «… bor» shu. Savol: Is there…? Are there…? Inkor: There isn’t / There aren’t.
f: There is + bitta · There are + koʻp · Is there…?
ex: There is a bank near my house.
There are many trees in the park.
q: There ___ a book on the table.
There ___ three rooms in our flat.
___ there a bus to the airport?
There ___ any milk in the fridge.

t: can / can’t — «qila olmoq»
d: can — «qila olmoq». Undan keyin feʼl oʻzgarmaydi va to qoʻyilmaydi: I can swim. Inkor: can’t (cannot). Savol: Can you…? Iltimos qilishda ham ishlatiladi: Can I sit here?
f: ega + can / can’t + feʼl · Can you…?
ex: I can speak a little English.
q: can dan keyin feʼlning oddiy shakli.
My little brother can ___ to ten.

t: Joy predloglari: in, on, under, next to, between
d: Oʻzbekchadagi -da, ustida, ostida kabi soʻzlar inglizchada otdan oldin alohida soʻz boʻlib keladi: in — ichida, on — ustida, under — ostida, next to — yonida, between — oʻrtasida, in front of — oldida, behind — orqasida.
f: in · on · under · next to · between · in front of · behind
ex: The cat is under the bed.
The bank is next to the school.
My car is behind the house.
q: The shop is ___ the bank and the cafe.
The dog is sleeping ___ the table.

t: Hozirgi davomli zamon: hozir boʻlayotgan ish
d: Ayni paytda boʻlayotgan ish uchun am/is/are + feʼl + ing ishlatiladi: I am reading — Men oʻqiyapman. Koʻpincha now, at the moment, Look! soʻzlari bilan keladi.
f: am / is / are + feʼl-ing
q: They are ___ football at the moment.

t: Odat yoki hozir? work va am working
d: Odat, doimiy holat uchun hozirgi oddiy zamon (I work every day). Hozirning oʻzida boʻlayotgan ish uchun davomli zamon (I am working now). Baʼzi feʼllar davomli shaklda deyarli ishlatilmaydi: know, like, want, need, understand.
f: every day, usually → work · now, at the moment → am working
ex: He usually walks to work, but today he is taking a taxi.
U odatda ishga piyoda boradi, lekin bugun taksida ketyapti.
We are watching a film now.
q: I usually ___ tea in the morning.

t: was / were — «edi»
d: am/is ning oʻtgan zamoni was, are niki were. I/he/she/it bilan was, you/we/they bilan were. Inkor: wasn’t, weren’t. Savol: Were you…?
f: I / he / she / it was · you / we / they were
ex: The weather was cold last week.
Were you at school on Monday?

t: Oʻtgan zamon: -ed
d: Oʻtgan zamonda koʻp feʼllarga -ed qoʻshiladi: work → worked, play → played. -e bilan tugasa faqat -d: live → lived. Undosh + y boʻlsa -ied: study → studied. Feʼl barcha egalar uchun bir xil boʻladi.
f: feʼl + ed (worked, lived, studied)
ex: I watched a film last night.
She lived in London for two years.
We visited our grandparents on Sunday.

t: Notoʻgʻri feʼllar: go → went, see → saw
d: Koʻp ishlatiladigan feʼllarning oʻtgan zamoni -ed bilan emas, boshqacha yasaladi. Ularni yodlash kerak: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, buy → bought, take → took, make → made, come → came, give → gave.
f: go → went · see → saw · buy → bought · eat → ate
q: I ___ a strange dream last night.

t: Oʻtgan zamonda savol va inkor: did / didn’t
d: Oʻtgan zamonda savol va inkor uchun did ishlatiladi. Shunda feʼl oddiy shaklga qaytadi: I didn’t go (went emas). Savol: Did you see…? Qisqa javob: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
f: didn’t + feʼl · Did + ega + feʼl…?
ex: I didn't sleep well last night.
q: We ___ go out because of the rain.

t: Kelajak: going to — reja
d: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan ish uchun am/is/are going to + feʼl ishlatiladi: I am going to visit my aunt. Koʻrinib turgan voqea uchun ham ishlatiladi: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
f: am / is / are going to + feʼl
ex: I am going to learn English this year.
They are going to buy a house.
Look at the sky! It is going to rain.
q: What ___ you going to do tomorrow?

t: Kelajak: will — qaror, vaʼda, bashorat
d: will kelajak uchun ishlatiladi: shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror, vaʼda yoki bashorat. will dan keyin feʼl oʻzgarmaydi: I will help you. Inkor: won’t (will not).
f: ega + will / won’t + feʼl
ex: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
q: I'm cold. — I ___ close the window.
She will ___ you at the station.
I promise I ___ be late again.
___ you help me with this bag?

t: Qiyoslash: taller than, more expensive than
d: Ikki narsani solishtirishda qisqa sifatlarga -er + than qoʻshiladi: tall → taller than. Uzun sifatlar oldidan more qoʻyiladi: more expensive than. Maxsus shakllar: good → better, bad → worse.
f: sifat + er + than · more + uzun sifat + than
ex: My brother is taller than me.
This phone is more expensive than that one.
q: A car is ___ than a bike.
This book is ___ interesting than the film.
My English is ___ now than last year.

t: Eng …: the tallest, the most beautiful
d: Koʻp narsa ichida «eng …» ni aytish uchun the + sifat + est yoki the most + uzun sifat ishlatiladi: the tallest, the most beautiful. Maxsus shakllar: good → the best, bad → the worst.
f: the + sifat + est · the most + uzun sifat
ex: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
She is the best student in our class.
This is the most beautiful city I know.
Bu men bilgan eng chiroyli shahar.
q: He is the ___ boy in the class.
It was the ___ day of my life.
This is the ___ expensive hotel in the city.

t: much / many, some / any
d: Sanaladigan otlar (apple, book) bilan many, sanalmaydiganlar (water, money, time) bilan much ishlatiladi. a lot of ikkalasiga ham mos keladi. Darak gapda va taklifda some, inkor va savolda odatda any.
f: many + books · much + water · a lot of + ikkalasi · some / any
ex: How many brothers do you have?
q: There are ___ people in the street.

t: Present perfect: hayotdagi tajriba (ever, never)
d: have/has + feʼlning 3-shakli (V3) hayotda biror marta boʻlgan yoki boʻlmagan ishni aytadi, vaqti muhim emas: I have been to Moscow. Savol: Have you ever…? Inkor: I have never…
f: have / has + V3 (been, seen, eaten)
ex: I have never seen the sea.
q: I have ___ this film three times.

t: Present perfect yoki oddiy oʻtgan zamon? just, already, yet
d: Aniq oʻtgan vaqt aytilsa (yesterday, in 2019, last week) oddiy oʻtgan zamon ishlatiladi: I saw him yesterday. Vaqt aytilmasa yoki natija hozir muhim boʻlsa, present perfect: I have lost my keys. just — hozirgina, already — allaqachon, yet — hali (inkor va savolda).
f: yesterday → saw · just / already / yet → have seen
ex: I have just finished my homework.
q: She has ___ left. You missed her.

t: Majburiyat va maslahat: must, have to, should
d: must — qatʼiy majburiyat yoki qoida: You must stop. have to — tashqi sabab bilan majburiyat: I have to work on Saturday. should — maslahat: You should see a doctor. mustn’t — taqiq, don’t have to — shart emas.
f: must / have to + feʼl (majburiyat) · should + feʼl (maslahat)
ex: You must wear a seat belt.
I have to get up early tomorrow.
q: You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
Tomorrow is Sunday, so I ___ go to work.
She ___ wear a uniform at school.

t: Real shart: If it rains, we will stay
d: Boʻlishi mumkin boʻlgan shart uchun: if + hozirgi zamon, natija qismida will. If it rains, we will stay at home. Diqqat: if dan keyin will qoʻyilmaydi.
f: If + hozirgi zamon, … will + feʼl
ex: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
I will call you if I have time.
q: If you ___ now, you will catch the bus.
If it is sunny, we ___ to the park.
She will be angry if you ___ late.
If I see him, I ___ him.

t: Oʻtgan davomli zamon: was doing
d: was/were + feʼl-ing oʻtmishdagi maʼlum paytda davom etayotgan ishni aytadi: At eight I was having dinner. Koʻpincha qisqa voqea bilan birga keladi: I was walking when it started to rain.
f: was / were + feʼl-ing … when + oʻtgan zamon
ex: I was reading when the phone rang.
They were playing football at five.
Soat beshda ular futbol oʻynayotgan edi.
What were you doing last night?
q: She was cooking when the lights ___ out.

t: -ing yoki to + feʼl: enjoy doing, want to do
d: Baʼzi feʼllardan keyin -ing keladi: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid: I enjoy reading. Boshqalaridan keyin to + feʼl: want, decide, plan, hope, need: I want to travel. Predlogdan keyin doim -ing: interested in learning.
f: enjoy / finish / avoid + -ing · want / decide / hope + to + feʼl
ex: I enjoy swimming in the sea.
U chet elda oʻqishga qaror qildi.

t: Majhul nisbat: is made, was built
d: Ishni kim qilgani emas, ishning oʻzi muhim boʻlsa, majhul nisbat ishlatiladi: be + V3. Hozirgi: English is spoken here. Oʻtgan: The house was built in 1990. Bajaruvchini by bilan aytish mumkin.
f: am / is / are + V3 · was / were + V3 (+ by …)
ex: English is spoken all over the world.
This mosque was built five hundred years ago.
Bu masjid besh yuz yil oldin qurilgan.
The letters are delivered every morning.
q: The book was written ___ a famous author.

t: Aniqlovchi gaplar: who, which, that, where
d: Odam haqida qoʻshimcha maʼlumot uchun who, narsa haqida which yoki that, joy haqida where ishlatiladi: The man who lives next door is a doctor. Oʻzbekchada bu «…gan / …digan» shakliga toʻgʻri keladi: qoʻshnida yashaydigan odam.
f: odam + who · narsa + which / that · joy + where
ex: The woman who works here is my aunt.
Bu yerda ishlaydigan ayol mening xolam.
This is the book which I told you about.
That's the restaurant where we met.
q: The boy ___ won the prize is my cousin.
I lost the bag ___ you gave me.
This is the town ___ I was born.
The film ___ we watched was boring.

t: used to — «oldin … edim»
d: used to + feʼl oʻtmishda odat boʻlgan, hozir esa yoʻq ishni aytadi: I used to play football — Oldin futbol oʻynardim. Inkor: didn’t use to. Savol: Did you use to…?
f: used to + feʼl · didn’t use to + feʼl
ex: I used to live in a village.
She used to have long hair.
We didn't use to have a car.
q: When I was a child, I ___ to swim in the river.
He used to ___ a lot, but now he doesn't.
Did you ___ to walk to school?
There ___ to be a cinema here.
There used to be — oldin bor edi.

t: Present perfect continuous: … dan beri
d: have/has been + feʼl-ing oʻtmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan ishni aytadi: I have been learning English for two years. for — davomida (two years), since — dan beri (2020).
f: have / has been + feʼl-ing · for + muddat · since + boshlangan payt
ex: I have been waiting for an hour.
She has been working here since 2018.
How long have you been studying English?
Qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini oʻrganyapsiz?
q: I have been living here ___ five years.
They have been playing ___ three o'clock.

t: Past perfect: had done — undan oldin
d: had + V3 oʻtmishdagi ikki voqeadan qaysi biri oldinroq boʻlganini koʻrsatadi: When I arrived, the train had left — Men yetib kelganimda poyezd ketib boʻlgan edi.
f: had + V3 (oldinroq voqea) … oʻtgan zamon (keyingi voqea)
ex: When we arrived, the film had already started.
Biz yetib kelganimizda film allaqachon boshlangan edi.
She had never flown before that trip.
U oʻsha safargacha hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan edi.
I realised that I had forgotten my passport.
q: When I got home, my family ___ dinner.
He was tired because he ___ all day.
By the time the police came, the thief ___.
I ___ never seen snow before I moved to Moscow.

t: Xayoliy shart: If I had…, I would…
d: Hozir yoki kelajakda real boʻlmagan, xayoliy holat uchun: If + oʻtgan zamon, natijada would + feʼl. If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world. to be bilan barcha egalarga were: If I were you…
f: If + oʻtgan zamon, … would + feʼl
ex: If I had more time, I would learn Chinese.
Koʻproq vaqtim boʻlganida, xitoy tilini oʻrganardim.
If I were you, I would accept the offer.
Sizning oʻrningizda boʻlganimda, taklifni qabul qilardim.
What would you do if you won the lottery?
q: If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
If she studied more, she ___ the exam.
I would help you if I ___ how.
If I were you, I ___ that.

t: Oʻtmishdagi shart: If I had known…
d: Oʻtmishda boʻlmagan holat va uning natijasi, koʻpincha afsus: If + had + V3, natijada would have + V3. If I had known, I would have helped you — Bilganimda, yordam bergan boʻlardim.
f: If + had + V3, … would have + V3
ex: If you had told me, I would have come.
If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
She would have passed if she had studied harder.
Koʻproq oʻqiganida, u imtihondan oʻtgan boʻlardi.
q: If I had seen him, I ___ hello.
If they ___ the map, they wouldn't have got lost.
She would have come if you ___ her.
We ___ the match if we had played better.

t: Oʻzlashtirma gap: He said that…
d: Birovning gapini yetkazganda zamon odatda bir qadam orqaga suriladi: «I am tired» → She said that she was tired. will → would, can → could, am/is → was. Buyruq yetkazilganda: tell somebody to do: He told me to wait.
f: say / tell + (that) + zamon bir qadam orqaga
ex: He said that he was busy.
She told me to call her later.
U menga keyinroq qoʻngʻiroq qilishimni aytdi.
q: «I am hungry.» → He said he ___ hungry.
«I will help.» → She said she ___ help.
«I can swim.» → He said he ___ swim.

t: Taxmin: must be, might be, can’t be
d: Taxmin qilishda: must — deyarli aniq ishonch (shunday boʻlsa kerak), might / may / could — balki, can’t — boʻlishi mumkin emas. He must be tired — U charchagan boʻlsa kerak.
f: must be (aniq) · might / may be (balki) · can’t be (mumkin emas)
ex: She must be at home; her car is outside.
U uyda boʻlsa kerak, mashinasi tashqarida turibdi.
q: He's been working all day. He ___ be tired.
I'm not sure. She ___ be at work.
That ___ be Ali. He is in London now.

t: Armon: I wish…
d: Hozirgi holatdan norozilik: I wish + oʻtgan zamon: I wish I had a car — Qani endi mashinam boʻlsa. Oʻtmishdagi afsus: I wish + had + V3: I wish I had studied harder — Koʻproq oʻqiganimda edi.
f: I wish + oʻtgan zamon (hozir) · I wish + had + V3 (oʻtmish)
ex: I wish I spoke English fluently.
I wish I had more free time.
Qani endi boʻsh vaqtim koʻproq boʻlsa.
She wishes she hadn't said that.
U buni aytmaganida edi, deb afsuslanadi.
q: I wish I ___ more money now.
I wish I ___ to the party yesterday.

t: Murakkab majhul nisbat: has been done, can be done
d: Majhul nisbat boshqa zamonlarda ham bor: present perfect — has/have been + V3 (The road has been repaired), modal feʼllar bilan — can/must/should be + V3 (This can be done today), kelajak — will be + V3.
f: has been + V3 · will be + V3 · can / must be + V3
ex: The bridge has been closed for repairs.
The results will be announced tomorrow.
This problem can be solved easily.
Bu muammoni osongina hal qilish mumkin.
q: A new school will be ___ next year.

t: Bogʻlovchilar: although, despite, however, therefore
d: although + toʻliq gap: Although it was cold, we went out. despite + ot yoki -ing: Despite the cold, we went out. however — biroq (yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan). therefore — shuning uchun (rasmiyroq).
f: although + gap · despite + ot / -ing · However, … · Therefore, …
ex: Although he was tired, he finished the work.
Charchagan boʻlsa ham, u ishni tugatdi.
Despite the rain, the match continued.
The test was hard. However, everyone passed.
Imtihon qiyin edi. Biroq hamma oʻtdi.
q: ___ it was late, she kept working.
___ the traffic, we arrived on time.
It was expensive. ___, we bought it.
He was ill; ___, he stayed at home.

t: Birovga qildirmoq: have something done
d: Ishni oʻzimiz emas, boshqa odam (usta, sartarosh) qilsa: have + narsa + V3. I had my hair cut — Sochimni oldirdim. I am going to have my car repaired — Mashinamni taʼmirlatmoqchiman.
f: have / get + narsa + V3
ex: I had my hair cut yesterday.
We are having our kitchen painted.
You should have your eyes tested.
q: I had my car ___ last week.
She is going to have her photo ___.
We ___ our house cleaned every month.
Where did you have your suit ___?
